summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour continues teaching the youth about the Hadith of Jibril, specifically focusing on the six pillars of Iman (Islamic faith). He covers belief in Allah, angels, books, and prophets, explaining that there are 315 messengers and 124,000 prophets, with key differences between the two roles. Sh. Ali Mashhour also discusses the five books mentioned in the Quran: the Quran, Torah, Injil, Zabur, and Suhuf Ibrahim, emphasizing that all important spiritual knowledge is contained within the Quran. The lesson concludes with an introduction to the fifth pillar of Iman: belief in the Day of Judgment, where Sh. Ali Mashhour uses practical examples to help young students understand why death gives life meaning and why the Day of Judgment is significant.
